classification.difficultyReason: Draw sums and differences of two vectors sharing a tail on a square grid.

spec.description: Eight-by-eight square grid with vectors sharing a tail. The blank-grid template cannot express the given vectors.
spec.mathematics: w moves 1 square left and 4 up; v moves 1 square right and 1 up.

sizing.reason: Match actual native12x9 response grids at4mm square units; retain full48x36mm drawing extent and allcells. Given8x8 grid has32mm actual drawing extent plus4mm label margins each side,40mm total. Native10pt labels preserved.

spec.description: Left third of the source response grid.

answer.worked: Place $\underset{\sim}{w}$ tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{v}$. The horizontal movements cancel, and the upward movements total 5 squares. Draw the resultant vertically upwards.

spec.description: Complete response grid with the resultant arrow.
